text:
Sam Patel: Pushed a tiny fix to the JS SDK ESM build that regressed the default export. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-js-sdk/pull/412
Praveen Iyer: taking a look
Sam Patel: it's just package/rollup tweak and an export change
Sam Patel: cc @Tanya Gomez @Liam Chen — can someone spare a quick approval? want to ship in today's deploy
ci-bot: build passed · 5 checks
Praveen Iyer: quick notes inline, two small suggestions
Praveen Iyer: 1) prefer `export default RedwoodClient` for backward compat
Praveen Iyer: 2) update CHANGELOG with a semver note
Sam Patel: will update both now
Sam Patel: patch snippet:
```
- export const RedwoodClient = ...
+ export default RedwoodClient
```
Liam Chen: question — will this break bundlers / require consumers to change imports?
Sam Patel: no, added interop shim in rollup config; tests cover cjs + esm
Tanya Gomez: LGTM after changelog update, won't block
Sam Patel: thanks — merging after Praveen approves
Praveen Iyer: approved
Sam Patel: merged and triggered staging deploy · https://staging.redwood.ai/sdk
ci-bot: deploy to staging succeeded · logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/12234
Liam Chen: smoke tested internal apps, all good :thumbsup:
Sam Patel: thanks team — canary to prod later today
Praveen Iyer: appreciate the quick turnaround
Sam Patel: np, much appreciated
